items.title: Uniform boundedness of the torsion of the first cohomology along modifications of a normal surface singularity
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a nonzero element of a two dimensional local normal Nagata domain there is an integer bounding the length of the cokernel of the restriction map from the base ring to the sections of the divisor cut out by that element along every normal modification (statement lines 1946-1956). The proof (proof lines 1958-2005) identifies that cokernel with the torsion of the first cohomology, reduces to an element with reduced quotient, compares with the normalization of the quotient and with the scheme theoretic closure of the divisor, and uses the injectivity of the restriction map to bound the torsion uniformly. H3: a reduction with a comparison argument, written out in full.
